name: Bazelisk
description: Default Bazel downloads GPG-signature-verified vs a pinned pubkey. Caveat: --last_green/fork builds set verifySignature=false.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Bazelisk includes detached-signature verification with an embedded Bazel release key for designated official release channels. Other configured channels differ; the evidence does not support one authentication classification for every source.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Bazelisk revision under study.
The review establishes the Bazelisk call-site policy and embedded-key check, but not release-server key custody or the authenticity of the remote signature itself.

original_evidence.text: | Bazelisk (bazelbuild/bazelisk) | https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazelisk.git | 5a7ff3892fdbd05672e6b8e60f139e05b2b76940 / 2026-04-27 | Y | Y | Y | https, TLS enforced (Go `http.DefaultTransport`, no InsecureSkipVerify found) | Y (release/rolling path only) | GPG detached signature (`.sig`) checked with `openpgp.CheckDetachedSignature` for the **default** LTS-release and rolling-release download paths | **pinned in binary** — `//go:embed bazel-release.pub.gpg` embedded public key (`httputil/httputil.go:45`) | `httputil/httputil.go:196-283` (DownloadBinary + verifySignature); call sites: `repositories/gcs.go:199` (DownloadLTS, verify=true, default path for a normal `USE_BAZEL_VERSION`), `repositories/gcs.go:277` (DownloadRolling, verify=true); **but** `repositories/gcs.go:228` (DownloadAtCommit/`--last_green`, verify=false) and `repositories/github.go:94` (fork-hosted Bazel binaries, verify=false) skip verification entirely; `core/repositories.go:31` wires `CreateRepositories(gcs, gitHub, gcs, gcs, true)` so LTS=gcs(verified) is the default |
